summary: Reproduced the reported Notes-page blank-document + download.html bug for session 10c9e2ec-ee33-4b2c-987a-eae4b40ed8c6 (student testagent2026@gmail.com). The frontend-only fix applied by the main agent to NotesPage.jsx DocumentViewer is NOT sufficient — it fixes a code path that is never taken for this card. Root cause is upstream (data / card metadata), and the new handleDownload() still silently 'succeeds' with an empty URL, saving the SPA's own index.html as 'Document.html'.

critical.issue: The document card served to the Notes page has content.file_url = "" (empty string), content.file_type = 'pdf' (NOT 'pptx'), and content.file_name = 'Document' (NOT 'notes.pptx'). This directly contradicts the review_request assumption that the card has file_type='pptx'/file_name='notes.pptx'. Because file_type is 'pdf', DocumentViewer takes the isPdf branch and renders <iframe src="">, producing a blank frame and the console error: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute'. Either the PPT upload flow is writing the wrong content JSON (file_type stuck at default 'pdf' and file_url never populated), or the migration/read query is dropping these fields. This is the actual origin of the reported 'blank notes page + garbage download.html' bug.

ui_bugs.issue: handleDownload does NOT guard against an empty/missing fileUrl. When c.file_url is '' (as it is for this card), fetch('') resolves to the current SPA page (200 OK, HTML body). The function happily wraps that HTML in a Blob and triggers a save as 'Document.html' — exactly the 'download.html, full plain' behavior the user reported. The fix must early-return / show an error when fileUrl is empty or not a valid absolute URL. Verified downloaded file is the Valuevade SPA index.html, 3334 bytes, starts with <!DOCTYPE html>.

The isPdf branch renders <iframe src={fileUrl} /> without checking that fileUrl is non-empty. Result: empty src → blank iframe → 'notes page shows blank' bug persists. Should also fall back to the 'Preview not available / Download' card when fileUrl is empty, or at minimum surface the viewerError state. The <iframe onError> handler is not fired for empty-src iframes, so setViewerError(true) is never called and the friendly fallback UI never appears.

isPdf is derived only from c.file_type. If the DB stores file_type='pdf' incorrectly but file_name ends in .pptx, the UI still tries to embed as PDF. Recommend falling back on the file extension of file_name (e.g. fileName.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pptx')) so the UI is resilient to bad file_type metadata — this would have masked the current data bug and shown the correct Download-only card.

integration_issues.issue: User-facing behavior is unchanged from the reported bug: (a) document frame is BLANK (iframe with empty src); (b) clicking Download saves 'Document.html' containing the Valuevade landing page HTML instead of the real .pptx file; (c) no error surfaced to the user. The main-agent's non-PDF branch fix is dead code for this card because isPdf=true.

action_items: PRIMARY: Investigate why the PPT card for session 10c9e2ec-ee33-4b2c-987a-eae4b40ed8c6 has content.file_url='' and content.file_type='pdf' in master_notes_cards. The admin PPT upload flow is likely not persisting file_url / file_type / file_name into the card's content JSON. Fix the upload/insert path.

Harden handleDownload() in NotesPage.jsx: if (!fileUrl) show a toast/error and return; also check response.headers.get('content-type') — if it's text/html, treat as failure and DON'T save the blob. This prevents the SPA HTML from ever being saved as 'Document.html' regardless of underlying data corruption.
Harden DocumentViewer render: if (!fileUrl) render the 'Preview not available' fallback card for BOTH PDF and non-PDF branches, so a bad card never shows a blank iframe.
Consider deriving isPdf from BOTH file_type AND file_name extension so a mis-tagged file_type does not send a .pptx down the iframe branch.
After the data fix, re-run this test — expect fileType='pptx', fileUrl to be a supabase storage URL, and the download to yield an actual .pptx (PK\x03\x04 zip signature).
critical_code_review_comments: handleDownload has no validation of fileUrl before calling fetch() — fetching '' returns the current page silently, defeating the purpose of the fix.
isPdf branch is not gated on fileUrl truthiness — empty src still renders, causing a silent blank iframe.
Frontend blindly trusts backend metadata; a defensive extension check on file_name would have prevented the reported symptom even without the data fix.

The 'download attribute is ignored cross-origin' comment/rationale in the code is correct in general, but the actual bug the user hit here is different (bad/empty file_url), and neither the old code nor the new code guards against it.

Verify master_notes_cards.content for card_type='pdf_document' on this session before re-testing the UI.
rca of the issue: 1) User uploaded a PPT via Admin. 2) The upload/insert path for master_notes_cards did NOT populate content.file_url / content.file_type / content.file_name correctly — card row exists with card_type='pdf_document' but content = {file_type:'pdf', file_url:'', file_name:'Document'} (defaults). 3) DocumentViewer picks isPdf=true from content.file_type and renders <iframe src=''> → BLANK page (this is the 'blank notes page' symptom). 4) User clicks Download; handleDownload() calls fetch('') which the browser resolves to the current page URL, returning the SPA's index.html with 200 OK. 5) The function saves that HTML as a Blob with filename 'Document' + no extension coerced by browser to 'Document.html' → this is the 'download.html full plain' file the user reported. Mitigation: fix the upload path to persist file_url/file_type/file_name; add defensive guards in DocumentViewer (empty-URL check, content-type check, extension-based file type detection).
